conviction_note: No estimates exist for this name, so there is no sourced bar. The evidence leans mildly up: an Israeli PCB peer reported Nov 10 that its Q3 gross margin rose q/q, the shekel reversed 2.85% weaker in Q3 after a 5.9% gain in Q2, the controlling shareholder bought a block at $9.00 in mid-September, and management guided Q2 to Q3 toward narrower gross losses. Against that: four straight negative earnings reactions (-20.0%, -0.5%, -2.5%, -11.4%), a new CEO's first print, and tightening laminate supply. p_up 54, sized on a rebuilt earnings base rate of about 8% (median |move| of the four verified releases is 7%, mean 8.6%), giving +0.64. The findings sum to +1.9 because each proxy is sized on its own. The scaled number is smaller because I hold most of the uncertainty about the sign in p_up.
bar: UNSOURCED: zero analysts cover ELTK (TipRanks shows consensus 'Based on 0 Analysts'; chartmill and benzinga estimate pages are blank). The implicit bar is the Q2 2026 run-rate: revenue $11.5m, gross loss $1.0m, operating loss $2.5m, net loss $0.41/share (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/eltek-ltd-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-302853951.html, 2026-08-18). Management's stated aim is to convert backlog into quarterly revenue above the first-half 2026 level of about $11m a quarter, with no numeric forecast (https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262115857-tradingkey). The year-ago Q3 2025 was revenue $13.3m and an operating profit of $0.05m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1024672/000117891325003886/exhibit_99-1.htm). Every finding is capped small because the bar is unsourced.
positioning_check: Short interest is tiny and not crowded: 4,500 shares short, days to cover 0.5, ShortSqueeze page dated 2026-11-06 (https://shortsqueeze.com/?symbol=ELTK); Massive shows 1.72K shares and 1.0 day as of 2026-09-30 (https://massive.com/quote/eltk). There is no options market (baseline status no_options_market), so no skew. The tape is extremely thin: 20-day average volume is 3,109 shares, about $18k a day. The controlling holder (Nistec Golan / chairman Yitzhak Nissan) owns 62.7% (13D/A 2026-09-15), so the free float is roughly 2.5m shares. Price has drifted from about $8.0 in early October to $5.92 on trickle volume with no EDGAR filing to explain it: -15.3% over 20 days, 1.7% above the 52-week low, -48% from the 52-week high. The baseline's 1.64% reaction scale is NOT an earnings base rate (cadence_implausible). Rebuilt from Yahoo daily closes around the four confirmed releases: Q3'25 2025-11-18 -20.0% (11.40 to 9.12, 30.8k shares); Q4'25 2026-03-09 -0.5%; Q1'26 2026-05-19 -2.5%; Q2'26 2026-08-18 -11.4%. All four were negative.

findings.finding: Israeli peer PCB Technologies (TASE: PCBT, Migdal HaEmek; also serves defense and semiconductor customers) reported on 2026-11-10 that Q3 2026 revenue was a record $50.5m, up 8% from Q2. Gross margin rose to 19.2% from 17.9% in Q2, net income was $3.1m against $1.1m, and backlog is about $270m. This is the first Israeli PCB print since Eltek last spoke on 2026-08-18. It shows a same-country, same-currency, same-materials maker improving margins q/q in Q3. The implicit bar for Eltek is a Q2 gross loss of $1.0m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Eltek's own gross-margin line has been the driver: Q3'25 GM collapsed to 12% (from 26%) and the stock fell 20.0%; the Q2'26 gross loss of $1.0m (narrowed from $1.8m) still drew -11.4%. There is no instance of a gross-margin improvement being rewarded yet.
findings.why_not_priced: ELTK has no analysts and trades about $18k a day. No one publishes a read-across from TASE-listed PCBT, and ELTK fell from about $6.6 to $5.92 in the sessions after PCBT's release. If the read-across were priced, ELTK would have held or bounced after Nov 10 rather than making new lows.
findings.independence: Proxy, not an Eltek number. PCBT is larger and more exposed to semiconductor and AI; Eltek is HDI/flex-rigid with heavy defense and medical exposure, and its own problems (ERP, plating line, foreign workforce ramp) are company-specific. The Eltek Q2 call (https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262115857-tradingkey) independently says ASPs are rising and gross loss is narrowing.

findings.finding: The Bank of Israel's Q3 2026 FX review (2026-11-03) says the shekel WEAKENED about 2.85% against the USD in Q3, after STRENGTHENING about 5.9% in Q2 (BoI Q2 review, 2026-08-02). Eltek attributed its Q2 financial expense of $0.7m to dollar erosion against the NIS, so the Q3 reversal implies a swing toward financial income on its dollar-net balance sheet. Operating-cost relief on NIS-denominated costs is also possible, though Q3 average rates were probably only modestly weaker than Q2 averages.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FX has been the company's stated explanation for every weak quarter. Q3'25 had about $0.8m of FX hit to operating profit (stock -20%), and Q1'26 had $1.3m of higher NIS costs (stock -2.5%). There is no history of the market rewarding an FX tailwind.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a macro series that nobody maps to a $40m-cap Israeli microcap with no coverage. If it were priced, the stock would not have kept falling through November.
findings.independence: The Q2 BoI review (https://www.boi.org.il/media/5lwekffl/foreign-exchange-market-2026-q2.pdf) gives the comparison quarter. Eltek's own Q2 release (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/eltek-ltd-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-302853951.html) links its financial expense to dollar erosion. The largest piece is below operating income, so it is sized as a fraction.

findings.finding: PCB material shortages intensified into Q3: Evertiq (2026-09-08) reports rising laminate prices, longer lead times and stricter allocation that now reach prepregs, copper foil and standard FR-4, with no easing for fibreglass fabric before 2028. Eltek said on its Aug 18 call that some suppliers had sharply raised prices or imposed quotas, and that it had secured enough material only through closer coordination. This is a cost and throughput headwind against the Q2 run-rate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1'26 raw-material shortages and logistics were cited in a quarter the market had been pre-warned about on April 1. The reaction was -2.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced: management flagged it in August and the stock has fallen 34% since mid-September. It is filed small because the size of the Q3 cost hit is not public.
findings.independence: Same-direction industry pieces: https://evertiq.com/news/2026-08-19-pcb-material-shortage-spreads-to-standard-fr-4-as-structural-shift-deepens (same outlet, so not independent). It is offset by finding 1: PCBT faced the same shortage and still widened margin.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call (2026-08-18), management said gross loss narrowed from $1.8m to $1.0m q/q on higher ASPs, and expects the repricing gains to build as newer orders take a larger share of mix. It split the backlog into thirds: legacy-rate, about NIS 3.2/$, and about NIS 3.0/$ (the most profitable). It aims for quarterly revenue above first-half levels, and said demand is not the constraint. The first new plating line only starts customer qualification in Q3 and needs several months, so it adds no Q3 capacity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The same 'gradual improvement' language accompanied Q1 and Q2; both were sold (-2.5%, -11.4%). The Q3'25 target of 26-27% gross margin by mid-2026 was missed badly.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced, because it is the company's own public trajectory, and the finding lands inside what management told the market to expect. It is kept only because the market has stopped believing it: the stock is 34% below mid-September.
findings.independence: Same company document as the Q2 release (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/eltek-ltd-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-302853951.html). Finding 1 (peer) is the independent check.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-06 Eltek announced $6.8m of repeat purchase orders from an international customer, delivering across 2027-2028, which the CEO said bring backlog to a 'record level'. The call will update the backlog figure. Backlog had already 'more than doubled' versus year-end 2025 by Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The order release day moved +2.8% (baseline row 2026-10-06). The April 1 backlog-doubling disclosure did not prevent later negative print reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public, so mostly priced; the stock fell from about $8.0 to $5.92 after it. The deliveries are in 2027-28, so they do not touch the Q3 numbers. What could move the stock is a quantified backlog figure on the call.

findings.finding: Controlling shareholder Nistec Golan (chairman Yitzhak Nissan) bought shares with personal funds between 7/14 and 9/15/2026, including a 169,357-share block at $9.00 and 60,433 shares at $8.98 on 9/14/2026 (243,300 shares traded that day). This lifted the stake from 3,730,802 shares (55.5%, 13D/A Amendment 9, event 12/03/2025) to 4,047,659 (60.2%), 62.7% with his direct holding. The chairman was buying in the last two weeks of Q3 at 52% above today's $5.92.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on an earnings day. The stock spiked to $9.00 on the block day and has since fallen 34%.
findings.why_not_priced: The filing is public, but the price has moved the other way. If the market read the insider's late-quarter buying as information about Q3, the stock would not sit 34% below his purchase price. The filing's own table is internally inconsistent ('Date of Sale' / 'Shares Acquired'), though Item 3 says personal funds and the holding rose.
findings.independence: Prior amendment for the comparison: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1024672/000117891325004017/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X01/primary_doc.xml. Against it: former director Dovev Gad exercised options and sold at $8.52 on 9/17 and 9/22 (Form 4s, small, a departing director).

findings.finding: This is the first print under a new CEO. Eli Yaffe retired effective 2026-09-23, and CFO Ron Freund became CEO while remaining CFO until a successor is named (none announced as of the Nov 9 date release, which lists him in both roles). A first print under new leadership raises the chance of write-downs, inventory or plating-line provisions, or a more cautious tone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior CEO transition print in the window. The CEO announcement day moved 0.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an inference, not a document. Freund was already CFO and ran the numbers, which lowers the kitchen-sink odds, so it is sized small with a wide band.
findings.independence: The earnings-date release (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/eltek-sets-earnings-release-date-and-conference-call-to-report-third-quarter-2026-results-on-november-17-2026-302933209.html) still lists Freund as CFO, so no new CFO has been named.

outside_window.finding: The second new plating line is due in Israel by year-end 2026, with contractual penalties on the supplier for delay; the first line needs several months of qualification before full commercial production. The capacity and margin benefit lands in 2027.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The -15% 20-day run-up and the position 1.7% above the 52-week low mean expectations are depressed, and my mild positive lean cuts against the tape. The name's own reaction history (four negative prints in a row) is the strongest counterweight, which is why p_up sits only at 54.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar unsourced, zero analysts): peer proxy cut from +1.5 to +1.2 to keep every finding small.
Rule 2 (one-offs below the operating line): FX finding cut from +0.8 to +0.5, since its largest piece is financial income with no path to guidance.
Rule 6 (inside what the company guided): the management-trajectory finding was cut from +0.5 to +0.3 because it lands inside management's own stated trajectory.
Rule 5 / table (already flagged by management): materials finding cut from -0.8 to -0.5. The inference-only CEO-transition finding was cut from -0.5 to -0.4.
Rule 5 (unexplained drawdown worth 0): the October-November slide is not filed as a finding.
'Reaction history from wrong events': already applied in the draft (base rate rebuilt from confirmed releases); abs_move 8 and p_up 54 unchanged.
